correctness.rationale: Proposition 14 gives a relative asymptotic uniformly over all admissible s. Setting s=n-2k yields Q(n,n-2k)-Q(n,n)=-k(n-1) and P(n,n-2k)=(n-2k-1)!k!2^k. Hence the exact comparison weights R_{n,k}. Their exact ratio is ((n-2k-1)(n-2k-2))/((k+1)2^n), making every k>=2 stratum geometrically negligible relative to k=1. The source's uniform relative error transfers both the overall equivalent and the conditional concentration. The checker verifies all algebraic identities and finite tail inequalities with exact arithmetic.

value.rationale: The result turns qualitative generic symmetry into a sharp exceptional-set law. It identifies the exact first-order nonsymmetry scale and proves that the exceptional population is itself concentrated on one converse pair, revealing a boundary-layer structure invisible in the source corollary.
